collection.title: MG MG 5 2020 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The MG 5 Estate 2022 Onwards requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 18" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.

image.alt: MG MG 5 2020 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
